sections.title: Latest AI/ML development and evolution
bullets: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra (~Sep 17, 2026): first OpenAI model rated Critical for cybersecurity under Preparedness Framework; Microsoft Foundry GA same day; Foundry pricing ~$10/$50 per M tokens short context.

Google Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (Sep 15–16): live voice models in Gemini API, AI Studio, Search Live; Extended Thinking in Gemini Live/Workspace; claimed #1 Speech-to-Speech Quality Index (82.6).
Gemini 3.8 Flash GA Sep 2; DeepMind Dream-RSI paper on arXiv Sep 14; Gemini 4 still in pre-training (no ship date).
Shanghai AI Lab Atria Dawn Preview (weights Sep 11): MIT-licensed 744B MoE (~40B active), agentic research/engineering, 256K context, HF + OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Ant Group Realtime-Venus (arXiv ~Sep 9–12): two 9B full-duplex models (Omni + Audio), Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face; quiet repo release.

sections.title: How the world is responding
bullets: Pace the Frontier selloff (Sep 12–15): Amodei slowdown essay; Altman/Musk agreed; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ~−5–6% on Sep 14; Nvidia ~−3.3%.
Trump dismissed AI-safety slowdown as a sick conspiracy / China race; Huang opposed slowing; Vance skeptical of labs seeking regulation.
Capex intact: Anthropic linked to $13.7B six-year compute deal same week; hyperscaler 2026 guidance raised/reaffirmed (Amazon ~$220B, Alphabet $195–205B, Meta $130–145B).
Rotation into software names priced as AI-disruption targets (Adobe, Autodesk, Intuit, etc.) as markets priced slower capability pace.

sections.title: New products launching that use AI/ML
bullets: OpenAI Agents API public beta (Sep 10): managed Codex-style cloud agent harness, sandboxes, subagents; pay tokens/tools only.
OpenAI GPT-Live-1 in API (Sep 10): full-duplex voice front-end at $0.05/min; Presence for enterprise voice agents.
GPT-6 Astra rolling to ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise, API, Azure, Bedrock; Enterprise off by default at launch.
Google Search Live + Workspace Live powered by Gemini 3.8 Live / Extended Thinking; SynthID audio watermarking.
Huawei Atlas 960E SuperPoD (Sep 17, HUAWEI CONNECT): NPO SuperPoD up to 4,096 NPUs for ~10T-parameter training/inference.

sections.title: Markets where AI/ML is still underused (sell opportunities)
bullets: Construction & built-world SMEs: scheduling, safety, document/BIM copilots for low-digitization field workflows.
Mid-market manufacturing & maintenance: quality inspection, downtime prediction, maintenance ops agents with clear labor ROI.
Agriculture / field ops: weather, pest, soil, market intel via WhatsApp/voice/SMS for smartphone-only distribution.
Insurance claims & underwriting: FNOL triage, coverage check, underwriting packet agents for semi-structured paperwork.
Healthcare admin: prior-auth evidence assembly and SMB clinical documentation still under-automated.
Legal / audit / PI ops: mid-market contract triage and matter workflows without enterprise AI budgets.
Property/facilities & local services: housing ops, transaction coordination, supplier risk for fragmented buyers.
